title: Normalized derived Zariski comparison on represented algebraic spaces
statement: Fix a scheme $S$ [def-pc-scheme] and algebraic spaces over it [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Use the ordinary Zariski restriction $r_Y$ and its ordinary context [def-sfb-space-zariski-ordinary-comparison], the unbounded localized derived categories with an arbitrary common localization morphism universe $w$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] [def-pc-derived-category] [def-sfb-space-derived-module-calculus], and their fixed K-injective right-derived functors. Derived Zariski data on $Y$ consist of an ordinary context whose extension $e_Y$ is additive and preserves finite limits and colimits, its induced derived functor $E_Y$, a factorization $Q_h E_Y\cong e_Y^h Q_h$, and an adjunction $E_Y\dashv Rr_Y$. Normalize that adjunction on every homotopy map $t:e_Y^hP\to I$: transposing the localization of $t$ through the factorization equals localization of its ordinary homotopy transpose followed by the universal right-derived unit at $I$ [def-sfb-space-affine-hom-comparison]. For two additive functors $F,G$, define their composite-derived unit on a complex $P$ by the termwise composition comparison, the universal unit for $G$ at $FP$, and $RG$ applied to the universal unit for $F$ at $P$. For $g:Y'\to Y$, a derived Zariski square consists of the ordinary normalized square and an isomorphism $Rr_Y Rg_{\mathrm{et},*}\cong Rg_{\mathrm{Zar},*}Rr_{Y'}$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. Its composite-derived units agree on every complex with localization of the termwise ordinary square followed by the other composite-derived unit. Define $E_{Y'} Lg_{\mathrm{Zar}}^*\cong Lg_{\mathrm{et}}^*E_Y$ to be the adjunction conjugate of this right square, using the fixed derived pullbacks [def-pc-derived-pullback] [def-sfb-space-derived-pullback] and normalized scheme adjunction [def-sfb-canonical-scheme-derived-adjunction-composition]. These are normalized comparison data, not a freely chosen natural isomorphism.
